cornerstone.notes: No cornerstone investors. The only occurrence of 'cornerstone' (PDF p.135) is figurative business text ('Leveraging brake-by-wire technology as the cornerstone'); there is no Cornerstone Placing section or Cornerstone Investment Agreement anywhere (searched 'cornerstone', 'Cornerstone Investment Agreement', 'Cornerstone Placing').

controller_6m.full_quote: Each of Mr. Tao and Ms. Liu has undertaken to each of our Company, the Joint Sponsors, the Overall Coordinators, the Joint Global Coordinators, the Joint Bookrunners, the Joint Lead Managers, the Hong Kong Underwriters and the Capital Market Intermediaries that, without the prior written consent of the Joint Sponsors and the Overall Coordinators (for themselves and on behalf of the Hong Kong Underwriters) and unless in compliance with the requirements of the Listing Rules: (a) he/she will not, and will procure that the relevant registered holder(s), any nominee or trustee holding on trust for him/her and the companies controlled by him/her will not, at any time during the First Six Month Period, (i) sell, offer to sell, accept subscription for, contract or agree to allot, issue or sell, mortgage, charge, pledge, hypothecate, lend, grant or sell any option, warrant, contract or right to purchase, grant or purchase any option, warrant, contract or right to sell, or otherwise transfer or dispose of or create an encumbrance over, or agree to transfer or dispose of or create an encumbrance over, either directly or indirectly, conditionally or unconditionally, any H Shares or other securities of our Company or any interest therein
controller_6m.basis: Contractual (Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement) undertaking by Mr. Tao and Ms. Liu (the Single Largest Group; the Company states it will have no controlling shareholder upon Listing, p.18 of PDF). 'First Six Month Period' is defined on PDF p.272 as ending on, and including, the date falling six months after the Listing Date, so free day is the day after 2027-02-07
controller_6m.notes: Not a Rule 10.07 Stock Exchange undertaking — '10.07' does not appear in this prospectus; this is the Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement lock-up.

controller_12m.notes: No Rule 10.07(1)(b) 12-month control undertaking found ('10.07' has zero hits; the underwriting section pp.263-266 contains only Company and Mr. Tao/Ms. Liu six-month undertakings).
